name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Campaigns-in-a-box, built with Generative AI as a core workflow tool rather than a novelty, is exactly what I build every day at Solenzo. I architect agent systems that turn a client's goals into structured, ready-to-execute content and outreach at scale, then design the evaluation frameworks that keep that AI-generated output accurate. That one-to-many model, one template base adapted across many clients instead of custom work every time, is the same shift this role is asking distribution partners to make.

On the channel side, I led onboarding and training for a reseller partner network at Birdeye, managing 15 to 20 partners and retaining 94% of them by building scalable communication workflows and catching adoption gaps before they became churn. At Wix, I built the sales training curriculum for tenured account executives, not just new hires, while managing a team of onboarding specialists. I don't have a background in 2-tier IT distribution specifically, and I want to be upfront about that. What I bring is real, current experience building the scalable programs and AI-driven content systems that this role runs on day to day.
I'd welcome the chance to talk through how that fits your distribution enablement strategy. I'm at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
